name: Truck Simulator Arizona
summary:
The open road, from the driver's seat - in Arizona.

THE PHOENIX LOOP
47 miles of real Phoenix freeway built from real map data: Loop 202 past Sky Harbor, Tovrea Castle and Tempe Town Lake, Loop 101 north through Scottsdale and west across north Phoenix, then SR-51 through Dreamy Draw and the Phoenix Mountains. Real ramps, real overpasses, saguaros, palms and the desert all around.
